basic_profile.bio: A seasoned cryptocurrency enthusiast and investor based in the Pacific Northwest. With a background in finance and computer science, I have been following the crypto markets since the early days of Bitcoin. I am passionate about technology, particularly blockchain and decentralized finance. Outside of my professional life, I enjoy hiking, reading sci-fi novels, and playing strategy video games. I typically browse Reddit during my morning coffee and late evenings. I work as a financial analyst and am happily married with two children.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in computer science and a master's in finance. Over the years, I've combined formal education with self-study to become proficient in blockchain technology and its financial implications. My work as a financial analyst involves analyzing market trends, and I apply similar techniques to the crypto market.
